note: READ THIS BEFORE READING ANY `repro` SCORE ON THIS ISSUE AS A REPRODUCTION. This predicate does NOT test the reported symptom, and no predicate over dxc's output can. #2922's defect is in DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare, a PIX pass that only IDxcOptimizer exposes; dxc.exe cannot run it, and dxc's own output is unchanged by the fix (commit c0676c7ca touched four files: two PIX passes under lib/DxilPIXPasses/, one inline helper in include/dxc/DXIL/DxilUtil.h, and PixTest.cpp -- nothing in the code path dxc.exe runs to produce DXIL). So this predicate matches identically before and after the fix, on every release from v1.6.2104 onward INCLUDING main. The symptom verdict for this issue is does-not-repro, and it was established by measure.py / manual-case-release-history.txt, NOT by this predicate or by any bisect over it. What the predicate does assert is the PRECONDITION for the bug, and that makes it the feature-presence control for the real measurement: clause 1 says -O1 hands the pass a POINTER-typed llvm.dbg.value for the local (the exact case the pre-fix pass early-returned on), and clause 2 says the amplification shader really compiled and DispatchMesh survived, so clause 1 cannot be satisfied by a stub. Both clauses are positive, so nothing here is satisfied for free by a compile that failed early -- there is no absence clause. A release that scores no-repro here did not produce the pointer case at all, so its pass behaviour is not evidence about #2922 either way: that is exactly v1.4.1907 (rejects as_6_5) and v1.5.2010 (emits no DILocalVariable and no llvm.dbg.* records for the local at any -O level). Controls: variant-od-main-debug.txt runs the same command at -Od and must NOT match, because at -Od dxc emits llvm.dbg.declare instead and no pointer-typed dbg.value exists -- that is the control which proves clause 1 is really testing the -O1 pointer case rather than matching any compile of this shader; variant-control-good-main-debug.txt compiles an unrelated ps_6_0 shader and must NOT match.
